title: the proof_coverage proof declares a budget over its measured run
intention: The proof_coverage proof declares a PROOF_TIMEOUT_S over its measured run, so a run on the tester's default budget seals it instead of timing out.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux: 8e2018855b31's walk hollow at 00:12 timed out at the tester's 120 s default for a proof that declares no PROOF_TIMEOUT_S (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:543), so clearance refused PROVED and kicked the ticket to FIXME; the walk's seal step timed out again at 00:32 ('1 proof · 0 green · 0 red · 1 timeout'). Two diagnostic runs under --timeout 1200 took 174 s and 166 s; the sealed hollow took 270 s. A proof that never finishes leaves no reading, so every default-budget caller turns a green proof into a timeout.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured): a proof that never finishes yields no reading, and clearance refuses the ticket on hollow_evidence_absent. Law 9: a timeout is red, never green.
how: The builder needs (a) the file, cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_proof_coverage.py; (b) the place: module level after the imports, beside PROVES, as `PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 900  # measured 174 s / 166 s runs, 270 s hollow, 2026-11-19 (ticket <id>)`, a plain int literal as the peers spell it (test_address_sieve.py:27); (c) one tooth that reads its own source and finds PROOF_TIMEOUT_S as an int above 270, appended to the proof's teeth; (d) a PROVES entry for this ticket mapping '1' to that tooth; (e) runs only through `bin/cairn test`.
constraints: every existing PROVES entry and tooth function in the proof stays unchanged
the tester's 120 s default (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:543) is not changed
